faqs: General
Which service should I start with?
Start with the problem causing the most difficulty. Hard to find online? Look at Google. Visitors leave without enquiring? Review your website. Replies or follow-ups get missed? Look at WhatsApp.
General
Do I need all three services?
No. You can start with one service. We recommend work based on your business needs, rather than asking you to take every service.
Website
Can Biltech improve an existing website?
Yes, we can review it. Whether an update or rebuild makes sense depends on its platform, condition and the changes you need.
General
Do you only work with Penang businesses?
Our focus is Penang SMEs. If you are elsewhere in Malaysia, contact us to discuss your project.
General
How long does setup normally take?
Timing depends on the work, your content, account access and any platform approvals. We agree a schedule after reviewing those requirements.
Website
Do you provide hosting?
Decision pending: hosting provider, charges, renewals and maintenance arrangements. These need to be confirmed in your proposal.
WhatsApp
Can I use my existing WhatsApp number?
It depends on your current account and the proposed setup. We check compatibility and any migration requirements before confirming.
WhatsApp
Does WhatsApp automation replace human replies?
No. Automation supports routine replies and enquiry handling. Your team takes over questions and conversations that need a person.
Google Business
Can you guarantee Google rankings?
No. We do not guarantee a Google position. Our work focuses on accurate profile information, useful content and genuine customer feedback.
Pricing
How much will my project cost?
Your quote depends on the pages, profile work and automation you need. Prices and package inclusions are pending confirmation; setup, ongoing and third-party costs will be stated in your proposal.
General
What does Get Free Advice involve?
Tell us about your business and what you want to improve. We can discuss whether Google, your website or WhatsApp needs attention first. Any proposed paid work is discussed separately.
Website
Who owns the website, domain and accounts?
Decision pending: ownership, account access and handover terms. Confirm these in writing before work begins.
General
Do you provide ongoing support?
Decision pending: support availability, included tasks, response arrangements and charges. Do not assume monthly support is included.
General
What will you need from me?
We will discuss the business information, photos, account access and approvals needed for your project. Exact content and approval responsibilities are to be agreed.
Website
Do I need a website or a landing page?
A landing page focuses on one offer or campaign. A website gives customers room to explore several services and your business. We can discuss which fits your needs.
Google Business
Can you help with a new or existing profile?
We can review an existing profile or discuss a new one. Setup depends on business eligibility, account access and any verification Google requires.
Google Business
Does this include ongoing review management?
Decision pending: ongoing review requests, reply writing and reporting. Your proposal must specify what is setup work and what continues afterwards.
WhatsApp
Are there ongoing WhatsApp costs?
The proposed setup may involve software and messaging charges. We confirm relevant third-party costs before implementation; ongoing support is to be agreed.
